findings.original_finding: The assigned artifact_commands string ends in a bare `python3 -m pytest -q tests`. It fails with exit 2 (4 collection errors, `No module named 'raptor_schema'`) because the pyo3/maturin extension is not installed. The tests only pass after `pip install .`, which CI runs and the policy command string does not.
findings.original_acceptance_criterion: Add `pip install maturin pytest markdown sc-compose && pip install .` (ideally in a venv) before pytest in the phase-end command block. Alternatively, expose one `just validate` or script target that includes the install step. Without it the phase-end proof fails or silently depends on whatever is installed in the host Python.
